## 2026-11-15：S2真实冻结组件完整页面适配／分层校准 v1

按原30清单每层首项固定VolumeControl、BatchRenamer、AnalyticsDashboard，使用20261104冻结源及该次summary最终San，不替换为后来手工修复版本。完成可信CommonJS SFC／静态本地依赖打包与独立v2完整截图，保留完整模板、内联子组件、默认props和CSS；**不是新模型批次或组件综合通过，生产阈值／repair反馈尚未接入。** 验证报告技能用于区分观察、源oracle问题和评估设施问题，旧131单元及元数据保留。

- 5场景／10页：Volume默认45及props60、Batch默认3文件及props2文件，共4静态场景像素差0、关键样式差0；只报告这些静态场景，不称任意方法／交互等价。
- Analytics双方7个子组件、30图点／15活动真实完成加载，7项根观察字段一致；源重复key产生10条带标签警告，San无错误，原生未处理异常0。完整页面1326／1625高、7项关键矩形差异，继续阻断，不缩放／裁切／编SSIM或差异图，也不计成目标新执行失败。
- 源普通scoped保留：父组件规则不能自然匹配内联子深层节点，而目标普通style可匹配，可解释部分布局差；未逐条证明全部差异根因。原生合成父／子隔离及显式依赖图等9项控制成立，不泛化成完整Vue3／任意SFC支持。
- 首轮复杂页PNG重复像素相同但观测不等。保留首轮及实现，新增完整重复观测并固定scrollbar-gutter；仅在内存改回auto的反事实重现styles／extent变化、宽1265→1280，而最终两次独立启动10页PNG SHA、业务记录及样式均一致。这是评估环境修复，无业务代码补丁或阈值放宽。
- 新39项+旧截图指标27项+动态公开键保护12项，共78项分别通过，非全仓库或旧273项campaign。扩展套件曾在repeat结果尚未落盘时setup失败，日志保留，待浏览器完成后同代码重测39项通过，不改skip。
- 58个既有相关文件、3个人工配置、6个冻结输入及旧75payload保持；无Prompt／迁移规则／产物／旧成绩改写，无新依赖／模型／人工确认／commit或push。原24/30、6失败、1,821,544 tokens保留；公开动态键及通知／异常风险不解除。

证据：`data/experiments/analysis/frozen_component_browser_v1_20261115/REPORT.md`；使用说明：`docs/ir-design/frozen-component-browser-v1.md`。1280×800／DPR1及旧时间随机／语言时区条件，完整截图限400万像素、横向溢出阻断。普通scoped使用compiler-sfc3.5.42和原生Vue2 _scopeId；ESM、setup、deep／slot、外部资源等明确拒绝。字体／浏览器未vendoring、CJK和emoji回退未逐字形固定；页面共享本次隔离profile/origin，本轮三组件无存储，不证明有存储组件的逐页隔离，也不证明完整状态空间／交互或恶意代码安全。

下一步先分开源oracle警告／目标差异／评估设施阻断的机器反馈，补存储与状态策略，再冻结生产协议／阈值并接入流水线；不能直接独立测试或付费全量复跑。下格仅只读核查本轮包，不重跑浏览器／模型；未打开Notebook UI。

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, re
root = next(p for p in [Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents] if (p / 'migration_pipeline').is_dir() and (p / 'notebooks').is_dir())
base = root / 'data/experiments/analysis/frozen_component_browser_v1_20261115'
read = lambda p: json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for line in (base / 'SHA256SUMS.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
    expected, relative = line.split('  ', 1)
    path = (base / relative).resolve()
    assert path.is_relative_to(base.resolve()) and sha(path) == expected, relative
baseline = read(base / 'baseline.json')
for path, expected in {**baseline['protected'], **baseline['manual']}.items():
    assert sha(root / path) == expected, path
assert len(baseline['protected']) == 58 and len(baseline['manual']) == 3
assert [r['component'] for r in baseline['selection']] == ['VolumeControl','BatchRenamer','AnalyticsDashboard']
for item in baseline['selection']:
    for field in ['source','target']:
        assert sha(root / item[field]['path']) == item[field]['sha256']
old_seal = root / baseline['old_evaluator_seal']['path']
assert sha(old_seal) == baseline['old_evaluator_seal']['sha256']
assert len(old_seal.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()) == 75
for line in old_seal.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
    expected, relative = line.split('  ', 1)
    assert sha(old_seal.parent / relative) == expected
prepared = read(base / 'prepared/manifest.json')
payload = read(base / 'prepared/payload.json')
assert len(prepared['pages']) == 10 and len(payload['pairs']) == 5
for page in payload['pages']:
    assert sha(base / 'prepared' / (page['name']+'.html')) == prepared['pages'][page['name']]['htmlSha256']
    assert hashlib.sha256(page['html'].encode('utf-8')).hexdigest() == prepared['pages'][page['name']]['htmlSha256']
results = [read(base / folder / 'result.json') for folder in ['corrected_run','repeat']]
for result in results:
    assert result['status'] == 'blocked' and not result['passed']
    assert all(c['status'] == 'captured' and c['stable'] and not c['changedObservationKeys'] for c in result['captures'].values())
    assert [p['passed'] for p in result['comparisons']] == [True,True,True,True,False]
    for pair in result['comparisons'][:4]:
        assert pair['eligible'] and pair['metrics']['changedPixels'] == 0 and pair['styleChanges'] == []
    pair = result['comparisons'][-1]
    assert not pair['eligible'] and pair['metrics'] is None and pair['diff'] is None
    assert pair['dimensions'] == {'source':[1280,1326],'target':[1280,1625]} and len(pair['styleChanges']) == 7
    for suffix in ['vue','san']:
        fields = result['captures']['analytics_default_'+suffix]['componentEvidence']
        assert fields['childComponentCount'] == 7 and len(fields['fields']['chartData']) == 30 and len(fields['fields']['activities']) == 15
    assert result['captures']['analytics_default_vue']['componentEvidence']['fields'] == result['captures']['analytics_default_san']['componentEvidence']['fields']
    assert not result['captures']['analytics_default_vue']['clean'] and result['captures']['analytics_default_san']['clean']
    assert len(result['exceptions']) == 0 and len(result['consoleErrors']) == 10
    assert all(r['args'][0]['value'] == 'Vue component warning' for r in result['consoleErrors'])
    assert result['transport']['blocked'] == [] and result['transport']['protocolErrors'] == []
    for name, capture in result['captures'].items():
        assert sha(base / ('corrected_run' if result is results[0] else 'repeat') / (name+'.png')) == capture['screenshotSha256']
assert results[0]['browser'] == results[1]['browser']
for name, capture in results[0]['captures'].items():
    other = results[1]['captures'][name]
    assert capture['screenshotSha256'] == other['screenshotSha256'] and capture['componentEvidence'] == other['componentEvidence'] and capture['styles'] == other['styles']
controls = read(base / 'controls/adapter_controls.json')
assert controls['allPassed'] and len(controls['checks']) == 9 and all(controls['checks'].values())
counter = read(base / 'gutter_counterfactual/result.json')
for capture in counter['captures'].values():
    assert not capture['stable'] and capture['repeatChangedPixels'] == 0
    assert set(capture['changedObservationKeys']) == {'styles','extent'}
    assert capture['extent']['width'] == 1265 and capture['repeatObservation']['extent']['width'] == 1280
assert not read(base / 'run/result.json')['captures']['analytics_default_vue']['stable']
tests = read(base / 'tests.json')
assert tests['tests_run'] == 78 and tests['exit_code'] == 0 and not tests['prior_273_rerun']
assert sorted(r['tests_run'] for r in tests['rows']) == [12,27,39]
assert all(r['exit_code'] == 0 and re.search(r'\nOK\s*$',r['output']) for r in tests['rows'])
assert tests['development_attempt_before_repeat_ready']['exit_code'] == 1
implementation = read(base / 'implementation.json')
assert len(implementation['files']) == 7 and not implementation['production_or_prompt_changed']
for path, item in implementation['files'].items():
    assert sha(root / path) == item['sha256'] and (root / path).read_text(encoding='utf-8') == item['frozen_source']
for item in read(base / 'packages.json')['packages'].values():
    assert sha(root / item['entry']) == item['sha256']
audit = read(base / 'audit.json')
assert audit['dynamic_public_key_block_retained'] and audit['paid_model_calls'] == 0 and not audit['existing_rules_or_prompts_modified']
assert audit['component_migration_passes_certified'] == 0 and not audit['production_thresholds_selected']
assert audit['original_batch'] == {'configured':30,'passed':24,'failed':6,'execution_errors':0,'total_tokens':1821544}
nb = read(root / baseline['notebook']['path'])
stable = lambda v: hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
assert stable(nb['cells'][:131]) == baseline['notebook']['cells_sha256']
assert stable(nb['metadata']) == baseline['notebook']['metadata_sha256']
print({'real_components':3,'static_visual_matches':4,'blocked_scene':'Analytics source warning / layout mismatch','new_tests':39,'targeted_tests':78,'production_integrated':False,'model_calls':0,'batch':'unchanged 24/30'})
